# Vertices

Source: [`Kernel/Vertices.wl`](../../Kernel/Vertices.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#vertices-kernelverticeswl--buildvertices)

BuildVertices: Fourier transform of the parsed density, vertices Gamma^(n) as symmetrised functional derivatives, the Gamma2 matrix and the Gamma3 matrices in the leg convention of docs/CONVENTIONS.md. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Vertices".

## Symbols

### `BuildVertices`

`BuildVertices[ansatz]` Fourier-transforms every monomial (dt -> +I w, grad -> -I q, all momenta incoming), builds every nonzero vertex Gamma^(n), n = 2..4, checks it against an independent plane-wave substitution into the density, prints the vertex table with its convention header and returns the "Vertices" stage.

### `VertexValue`

`VertexValue[vertices, {a1, ..., an}, {{w1, q1}, ..., {w(n-1), q(n-1)}}]` is Gamma^(n)\_{a1...an} with leg j at (wj, qj) and the last leg at -(sum of the others); vectors are symbols, scalar products `scal[a, b]`.

### `Gamma2Matrix`

`Gamma2Matrix[vertices, w, q]` is the matrix Gamma2\_ab(w, q) (leg a at (w, q), leg b at (-w, -q)) in field order, without regulator.

### `Gamma3Matrix`

`Gamma3Matrix[vertices, i, {nu, p}, {w, q}]` is the matrix with entries Gamma^(3)\_{i a b}: leg i at (nu, p), leg a at (w, q), leg b at -(nu + w, p + q); i is a field or its position in the field order.

### `ShowVertex`

`ShowVertex[vertices, {a1, ..., an}]` prints Gamma^(n)\_{a1...an}(w1, q1; ...; w(n-1), q(n-1)), last leg = -(sum).

### `ShowGamma2`

`ShowGamma2[vertices]` prints the nonzero entries Gamma2\_ab(w, q) (without regulator).

### `ShowVertexTable`

`ShowVertexTable[vertices]` prints the convention header and every nonzero vertex (done by BuildVertices).
